target: https://admin.mikbill.pro (public demo). One read-only call on the demo subscriber, then writes on a throwaway MCPTEST subscriber (uid 915, soft-deleted afterwards). Run from the signed-in admin page; no other record was changed.
method: The routes were found in the admin UI's own code (the app.js bundle): which form posts to which URL, and which fields each form has. Each route was then called directly and the effect read back with getuserdatambp.

already_in_the_server./json/users/paymentdoflex: mb_create_payment. The UI uses it for four operation forms (promotion, recalculation, subscription fee, connect/repair), each with its own list of bughtypeid values.

mb_get_payment_info.used_by: The Payment window loads it (uid) and shows the values.
mb_get_payment_info.response: {success: true, error: 0, data: [{abonplata, abonplata_installments, abonplata_real_now, abonplata_subscriptions, abonplata_user_dev, date_itog, days_left, deposit, itog_summa, total_payments}]}
notes: itog_summa is the recommended payment. On a new user it was 266 (240 tariff + 31 subscriptions - 5 balance).

mb_receive_payment.used_by: The Payment window of a subscriber (the main 'pay' dialog, with fiscalization and non-cash options).
request_notes: `print` is a client-side switch (print a receipt in the browser); it is not exposed.
prim2 is not required by Mikbill (a payment without it succeeded) but the tool requires it so every payment has a note.

beznal_payment 1 and beznal_date YYYY-MM-DD were accepted; do_fiscalization 0 and 1 were accepted. The demo has no cash register integration, so what fiscalization does on a real installation was not observed.
mb_receive_payment.response: {success: true, error: 0, data: [{address, bughid, bughtime, company_id, credit, deposit, fio, ok}]}. It is a receipt: bughid is the payment id and deposit and credit are the values BEFORE the payment (the first test showed deposit -1 and the balance afterwards read 4).
verified: beznal_payment 1 with beznal_date 2026-11-15: succeeded (+2). do_fiscalization 0 and 1: succeeded (+1 each).
history type of these payments is 'Пополнение счета' (a plain top-up).
mb_receive_payment.silent_no_ops: deposit 0 and deposit -3 answer {success: true, data: [{ok: 0}]} and change nothing. The tool refuses amounts <= 0 so this cannot look like a payment.
errors: Without uid: {success: false, error: 1, errorKey: 'uid', errortext: 'Не указан обязательный параметр: uid'}.

mb_set_credit.used_by: The Change-credit window of a subscriber. The bulk form posts to /extjs/users/creditmulti with set_users_list; the server's mb_bulk_issue_credit uses /json/users/creditmulti.
verified: credit 10: the subscriber's credit read 10. credit 25 afterwards: 25. It REPLACES the credit, it does not add.
credit 5000 (the demo's maximum is 1500): {success: false, error: 2, error_text: 'credit summa greater than allowed'}; credit stayed 0.
credit 0 and credit -5: {success: true} and nothing changed (silent no-ops; the tool refuses them).
creditnullfl (mb_remove_credit_single) set the credit back to 0.
errors: This route says error_text, not errortext. The server's error mapping now reads both.
Without credit: {success: false, error: 1, error_text: "parameter 'credit' not found"}.
Without uid or with an unknown uid: {success: false, error: 1001, error_text: 'user not found'}.
mb_set_credit.related_not_exposed: /extjs/users/creditsumma?uid= answers the limits: {credit_maximum: '1500.00', credit_summa: '0.00', credit_type: 1, will_be_avilable_days: 0, ...}. The UI calls it only when the installation's do_credit_like_cabinet option is 1. It could become a read tool (mb_get_credit_info).

cleanup: The MCPTEST subscriber (uid 915) was soft-deleted (state 4). The payments made on it (+9 in total) stay in the demo's history.

mb_list_payment_types.found_because: Bug report: an agent could not make a payment because it could not find a valid bughtypeid. mb_create_payment and mb_bulk_payment require one, and no tool listed them.
mb_list_payment_types.request: None. Each list is one POST with no parameters.
mb_list_payment_types.response: {success: true, data: [{bughtypeid, typename}]}. Names are Russian translation strings.
mb_list_payment_types.used_by: The four operation forms of the admin UI: subscription fee (abonplata), promotion (akciya), recalculation (pereschet) and connect/repair (podkl). Each form has a combo bound to its own list; all of them post to /json/users/paymentdoflex.

fee.1: Subscription fee for the current month
fee.2: Subscription fee for the current day
fee.22: Residual fee for the current month

findings: Mikbill does not validate bughtypeid: type 9999 answered {success: true} and recorded a payment of +1 whose history type is empty. The server therefore checks the id against these lists and refuses unknown ones before sending.
No bughtypeid at all answers {success: false, error: 1202, errortext: 'Something went wrong. Error (1202) is written to the general log'}, and nothing changes.

Type 17 (promotion) with deposit 1 added 1 (history type 'Акция'). Type 104 (fee, 'Пеня') with deposit 1 took 1 off the balance (history amount -1): fee types charge the subscriber, so the amount stays positive and the type decides the direction.
-1 ('Set balance') is in the correction list. The UI allows negative amounts for it and for type 10, but the server only accepts amounts above 0 and ids of 0 or more, so -1 is left out of the lookup.
mb_list_payment_types.writes_made: One more MCPTEST subscriber (uid 916), four payments of 1 on it, then soft-deleted.
